jobs.occupation: Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Field Service (Business-Analyst/in)

Optimization.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process-mapping sessions, and refinement meetings to analyze Design and Salesforce Configuration- Design functional solutions for Salesforce Field Service, Service Cloud, and Platform capabilities with Product Owners, architects, developers, integration or proof-of-concept configurations and conduct end-to-end impact assessments covering processes, data, integrations, automation, reporting, permissions, mobile use, and dependent platform streams.- Components, or other coded solutions are required, as software development is outside this role.Technical Service Process Ownership Support- Act as a functional expert for Technical Service, Field Service, and Service Cloud processes and capabilities, including case lifecycle, routing and queues, email and service channels, Work Order Management, Scheduling, the Field Service Mobile App, automation, and service reporting.- Promote consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems.- Advance reusable global templates and capabilities while enabling justified, controlled localization, and identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the evaluation and responsible adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities for Customer Service and Field Service use cases, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results from requirements and acceptance criteria; prepare and execute functional testing and support system integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness assessments, deployment preparation, release notes, and post-deployment validation, and provide hypercare by prioritizing incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancement demands.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Technical Service stakeholders, communicate effectively with business and technical audiences, and facilitate alignment and decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Collaborate with local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, and end-user support, providing expert guidance on complex or escalated topics and supporting process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Technical Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, accounts, work orders, assets, locations, and product items.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service-performance monitoring, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement; analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify opportunities.- Provide expert-level functional support for complex or escalated Technical Service topics and coordinate with technical teams as required.Your qualifications- University degree in business administration, economics, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least 5 years of professional experience in Business Analysis, CRM, Technical Service, commercial operations, or a related environment (preferably Pharma or Life Sciences), including at least 3 years of hands-on Salesforce Field Service experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or in a comparable role.- Proven experience in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshop facilitation, user-story writing, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment.- Hands-on knowledge of Salesforce declarative configuration and low-code capabilities, including Salesforce Flow, with the ability to implement controlled changes without code and assess automation impacts, error handling, maintainability, and testing needs.- Solid understanding of jobs.description: Worldwide Sales & New Business Development Neschen, part of Henkel, develops and manufactures self-adhesive graphic media and coating solutions. jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content GenerationYou are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.Your Profile- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs- natural language generation and explainability- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.Funding & Appointment TermsThe appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:- Monthly stipend of €1,650- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)Application Details- Expected start date: February, 2026Application package must include:- Curriculum Vitae (CV)- Academic transcripts- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals- 2 recommendation lettersApplications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Du kommunizierst während des gesamten Tagesablaufs auf Englisch mit den Kindern und begleitest sie mit Begeisterung, Kreativität und Einfühlungsvermögen.Das erwartet dich bei unsEine bilinguale UmgebungDu unterstützt aktiv die Entwicklung der Kinder in englischer Sprache, setzt dabei unsere pädagogischen Grundsätze um und gehst individuell auf die Bedürfnisse jedes Kindes ein.Zeit für hochwertige pädagogische ArbeitBeobachtung und Dokumentation sind wichtige Bestandteile unserer Arbeit. Wir geben dir die notwendige Zeit und den Raum, um die Entwicklung jedes Kindes bewusst zu begleiten und zu dokumentieren.Kontinuierliche WeiterbildungWir glauben an lebenslanges Lernen. Regelmäßige Fortbildungen und 8 fest eingeplante Konzepttage pro Jahr geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine pädagogischen Kompetenzen zu erweitern und dich persönlich sowie beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.Ein internationales TeamDu wirst Teil eines vielfältigen und internationalen Teams, in dem unterschiedliche Kulturen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven geschätzt werden. Wir ermutigen dich, deine eigenen Ideen einzubringen und etwas zu bewegen.Digital & unkompliziertUnsere Glückskinder-App übernimmt viele organisatorische Aufgaben im Alltag und gibt dir dadurch mehr Zeit und Energie für das, worauf es wirklich ankommt: die Kinder.Attraktives Gehalt & zusätzliche LeistungenWir schätzen deine Arbeit und dein Engagement. Neben einem leistungsorientierten Gehalt erwarten dich unter anderem eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, ein Fahrtkostenzuschuss, JobRad und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.🌴 Flexible UrlaubsplanungDa es nur wenige festgelegte Schließzeiten pro Jahr gibt, hast du mehr Flexibilität bei der Planung deines Urlaubs und kannst Beruf und Privatleben besser miteinander vereinbaren.✨ Das bringst du mit- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Erzieher/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Pädagogik, Frühpädagogik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und echte Freude daran, täglich mit Kindern Englisch zu sprechen- Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau sind zwingend erforderlich- Leidenschaft für die Arbeit mit Kindern im Alter von 6 Monaten bis 6 Jahren- Einfühlungsvermögen, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und ausgeprägte pädagogische Fähigkeiten- Kreativität und viele Ideen, um den Alltag und das Lernen abwechslungsreich und spannend zu gestalten- Offenheit für neue pädagogische Ansätze sowie die Bereitschaft, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickelnWerde Teil der Glückskinder-Familie – und hilf Kindern dabei, zu wachsen, zu entdecken und sich zu entfalten.

improvement.• Solid experience with incident, problem, and escalation management in production environments.• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, networking, operating details of our D3 product family.• Fluent English skills.Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:• ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.• Experience with AIOps, operational automation, or cloud-native transformation.• Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services.• German language skills.What we offer as an employer• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.• Be part of an international work force: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.• Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.• Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.• Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.Our commitment to inclusion:We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders and identities, and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive teamAbout usDIGITEC Our innovative products encompass a wide spectrum, from pricing and settlement solutions for FX/MM businesses to FX market data services. With over 40 prominent banks worldwide, spanning Europe, America, Asia, and Australia, among our esteemed clientele, we have solidified our position as a global leader.At the heart of our success is our exceptional team, comprised of approximately 80 dedicated professionals boasting expertise in software development, financial mathematics, sales, IT systems, and more. Operating from three key locations—Hamburg (headquarters), London, and Singapore—we champion equal opportunities and foster a culture of respect and collaboration, ensuring a welcoming and supportive work environment for all.Join us as we continue to redefine the landscape of financial technology with DIGITEC.

This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. Instead, send us a brief project portfolio describing a project you have taken from the initial phase through execution and final handover, highlighting your responsibilities, key challenges, and achieved results.**Take Your Opportunity - **Join us and actively contribute to the continued growth and development of our company. jobs.occupation: Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Customer Service & Platform (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usAs Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) - Customer Service & Platform, you are responsible for analyzing, shaping, documenting, and supporting the implementation of business requirements for the Customer Service and Platform stream within the global Customer Engagement ecosystem (Salesforce CRM), with a strong focus on Salesforce Service Cloud and Platform capabilities.You act as the key interface between Customer Service stakeholders, Product Owners, technical teams, and regional or local CRM specialists. The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. You translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and solution concepts and can independently implement approved no-code and low-code changes within the applicable governance framework.Your focus is on scalable, harmonized, and user-centered Customer Service and Platform solutions. You ensure that global processes can be adopted effectively across regions while enabling appropriate localization for market-specific operational and regulatory requirements. You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, customer interactions, knowledge, entitlements, service channels, automation, data quality, reporting, and related integrations.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process mapping, and refinement sessions with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; analyze processes, pain points, objectives, user needs, dependencies, risks, and business value.- Translate business needs into complete, consistent, testable, and traceable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, data, and non-functional requirements aligned with platform strategy and scope.- Challenge demands and identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, reuse, automate, or leverage existing Salesforce capabilities.- Maintain and prioritize the backlog with the Product Owner based on value, urgency, risk, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; document requirements and decisions in JIRA and Confluence.Functional Solution Design and Salesforce Configuration:- Design maintainable Service Cloud and Platform solutions with Product Owners, architects, developers, integration specialists, data teams, and other platform streams, assessing standard functionality, configuration, low-code automation, integration, or custom development.- Configure approved no-code and low-code changes within governance and deployment processes, including objects and fields, layouts, Dynamic Forms, record types, Lightning pages, list views, queues, assignment and validation rules, reports, dashboards, Flow automation, and other declarative capabilities.- Create prototypes or proof-of-concept configurations and assess end-to-end impacts on processes, data, integrations, automation, reporting, permissions, mobile use, and dependent platform streams.- Ensure compliance with architecture, security, access-control, data protection, naming, documentation, and release standards; collaborate with developers for Apex, Lightning Web Components, or other coded solutions, as software development is outside the role.Customer Service Process and Platform Ownership Support- Serve as functional expert for Customer Service processes and Service Cloud, including case lifecycle, inquiries, interaction history, routing and queues, service channels, knowledge, entitlements and milestones, templates, automation, and reporting.- Drive consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems; evolve reusable global templates while enabling justified, controlled localization.- Identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the responsible evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results; prepare and execute functional testing and support integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness, deployment preparation, release notes, post-deployment validation, and hypercare; help prioritize incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancements.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; communicate effectively with business and technical audiences and facilitate decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Guide local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, end-user support, and complex or escalated topics.- Create or support process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Customer Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, interactions, accounts, contacts, knowledge, entitlements, and service history.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service performance, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement.- Analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify improvements; provide expert functional support for complex or escalated topics and coordinate with technical teams as needed.Your qualifications- Degree in business administration, economics, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.- At least 5 years in Business Analysis, CRM, Customer Service, commercial operations, or a related field—preferably Pharma/Life Sciences—including 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud experience in a BA, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or similar role.- Expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshops, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, stakeholder alignment, agile delivery, JIRA, and Confluence.- Hands-on Salesforce declarative and low-code configuration, including Flow; able to implement governed code-free changes and assess automation, errors, maintainability, and testing.- Strong Service Cloud knowledge: case management, routing/queues, channels, knowledge, entitlements, automation, security, data models, reporting, and integrations.- Experience in functional testing, UAT, defect triage, releases, and hypercare; knowledge of role-based access, profiles/permission sets, data protection, auditability, and controlled deployments.- Salesforce Business Analyst certification required or obtainable within an agreed period; Administrator and Service Cloud Consultant certifications strongly preferred.- Strong analytical, conceptual, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills; able to balance value, user experience, standardization, risk, and maintainability.- Structured, independent, collaborative, results- and detail-oriented; accountable, interculturally competent, fluent in English, additional languages advantageous, and willing to travel internationally at least 30% as required.What we offerJoin #futurefresenius and drive the future of MedTech Quality with us. Make an impact in a strategic role that shapes organizational excellence in medical technology.ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application and join our team.
